title: Bind Vercel AWS OIDC Provider to Explicit Region

transitions.note: Created during pre-AWS runtime audit after confirming V201-12 is already allocated to the KMS extra-context policy canary.
Pass AWS_REGION explicitly to the Vercel AWS OIDC credential provider so STS resolution does not depend on the ambient AWS SDK region chain.

PR CI passed audit, typecheck, lint, unit tests, env/model verifier tests, build, state/docs checks and smoke; Vercel preview passed. Regression test confirms roleArn and clientConfig.region are supplied to the Vercel AWS OIDC credential provider.
Explicit STS/OIDC region hardening completed with no AWS resource, env, credential, database, route or paid-traffic mutation.

notes: Completed. The KMS client and Vercel AWS OIDC credential provider now both use the validated AWS_REGION explicitly. Live AWS canaries remain pending external infrastructure deployment.
